business_summary: Gifore Agricultural Science & Technology Service Co.,Ltd offers agricultural machinery in China. The company provides traditional agricultural machinery, vegetable farm machinery, orchard machinery, livestock machinery, smart agriculture, and freight trucks and related solutions. Gifore Agricultural Science & Technology Service Co.,Ltd was formerly known as Gifore Agricultural Machinery Chain Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Gifore Agricultural Science & Technology Service Co.,Ltd in September 2018. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
business_summary_ko: Gifore 농업 과학 기술 서비스 유한 회사는 중국에 농업 기계를 제공합니다. 전통농업기계, 채소농업기계, 과수원 기계, 축산기계, 스마트 농업, 화물트럭 등 관련 솔루션을 제공하는 회사입니다. Gifore Agricultural Science & Technology Service Co.,Ltd는 이전에 Gifore Agricultural Machinery Chain Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2018년 9월에 Gifore Agricultural Science & Technology Service Co.,Ltd로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 1994년에 설립되었으며 중국 청두에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
